items.quote: Keep Austin Weird is an unofficial slogan of Austin, Texas
Ann W. Richards Congress Avenue Bridge is home to the world's largest urban bat colony, which is composed of Mexican free-tailed bats
items.note: Rechecked after the answer was updated to give both the common and the official (2006) name. One answer.

items.quote: Austin City Limits is an American live music television program recorded and produced by Austin PBS
items.note: Pilot: "The pilot was shot on October 17, 1974, and starred Willie Nelson" (same article; a B.W. Stevenson taping the night before was unusable, so the Willie claim stands). "Takes its name from the city" hands over half the answer; fine as an easy one. Do not accept the ACL Music Festival, which is a spin-off.

items.quote: The Texas Longhorns are the athletic teams representing the University of Texas at Austin
Located in Zilker Park, the pool exists within the channel of Barton Creek and uses water from Main Barton Spring
items.note: Temperature "hovers between about 68 and 74 F year-round" per the same article. Deep Eddy Pool is also spring-fed in Austin but is not in Zilker Park, so the question is unique as worded.

items.quote: South by Southwest (SXSW) is an annual conference and festival that takes place in March in Austin, Texas
items.note: Still true in 2026 (SXSW 2026 ran March 12-18), but watch it: the Austin Convention Center is closed for rebuilding until 2029, SXSW runs "campus style" 2026-2028, and there is now a SXSW London in June. "Four letters" gives it away; fine as an easy one.

items.quote: Lady Bird Lake (formerly, and still colloquially referred to as, Town Lake) is a river-like reservoir on the Colorado River in Austin, Texas
items.note: This is the Colorado River of Texas, not the Grand Canyon one; a host should expect someone to object and be ready to say so.

items.quote: the presidential library and museum of Lyndon Baines Johnson, the 36th president of the United States (1963–1969). It is located on the grounds of the University of Texas at Austin
In 1839, the site was chosen, and briefly incorporated under the name "Waterloo"
The city's official slogan promotes Austin as "The Live Music Capital of the World"
items.note: Mild overlap: the Austin City Limits lead sentence (Q3's source) quotes this slogan, and Q1 and Q10 are both finish-the-slogan questions. Consider varying one.
